summary: V3-08 repair candidate accepted. The candidate is a non-empty delta (changedFiles=2, hasDelta=true, verificationOnly=false, agentExitCode=0) repairing the trusted finalizer step-7 blocker of Actions run 35470723768 within Builder scope: scripts/e2e-android.js and scripts/finalizer-e2e.sh only. Public run metadata confirms steps 5-6 (product/privacy/cost gates, release APK assembleRelease, iOS export, APK locate/hash) succeeded and only step 7 (Android API 35 install/launch/golden path) failed. The repair removes the adb kill-server/start-server restart from launch() (executed under cold-start load, immediately before the uiautomator warm-up dump) and the post-install restart in finalizer-e2e.sh, keeping the pre-E2E restart at idle and all reactive adbReconnect() recovery paths (adb() retry, dumpUi() cat-failure, waitFor() consecutive-failure). Rationale: a server-process restart under heavy Hermes cold-start load disrupts the adb transport exactly when the uiautomator server needs to initialize, so the warm-up dump fails and the first real dumpUi() blocks for the full 45s timeout, burning the Demarrer waitFor() window. The 360s Demarrer window is unchanged; the reduced sleeps (60s->30s) are non-deadline and do not shrink the window. No E2E assertion weakened (golden-path steps byte-identical), no product code, tests or protected control-plane files changed, diagnostic evidence capture preserved. Trusted verification passed exit 0: typecheck, 432 tests (22 suites), privacy 71 tests, cost 21 tests (10 gates), expo export android, prebuild, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL. All V3-01..V3-07 invariants preserved; no chrono/premium/paywall/warm-V2 reintroduction; no cost regression (CI-script-only delta). Empirical confirmation of the emulator fix remains with the next trusted finalizer run.
